paragraphs.text: Nazahn , Revered Blacksmith , is a legendary nacatl artificer from Naya , on the plane of Alara .

Once an ordinary blacksmith, his life changed when the Conflux merged his home with the shard of Bant . Nazahn found fame as a renowned weaponsmith for the knightly orders on Bant and now wields a magical hammer of invincibility that allows him to hold hot, fiery metal, without so much as singeing his fur.
